caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest with a hinged lid, decorated with intricate and colorful patterns. The chest features a color palette of beige, blue, red, and gold. The front panel shows a symmetrical floral design with stylized flowers and leaves in blue, red, and green, with a prominent central flower. The side panel displays an eight-pointed star motif in black and red, set against a beige background framed by blue borders. The top surface of the chest has a rectangular panel with more subdued, lightly sketched designs. The edges of the chest are outlined in dark blue, and the four feet at the base are also painted a darker color, possibly brown or dark blue. The composition is centered on the chest with a plain, light background. The bottom right corner of the drawing contains the handwritten name "BETTY JEAN DAVIS."
title: Pa. German Sample Chest
